Hang your bike up in the garage over winter? No way! We have a 3-day indoor Trial course for you. You'll improve your balance, learn to ride over a beam and up onto pallets, get the correct position on the bike and learn a few other tricks you'll find priceless off-road. We know how demanding Trial looks to many riders at first glance. Thanks to our experience we believe that within a few lessons you'll understand the basics of how to develop in this discipline and combine it with your main one. Bike rental is included in the price.


LOCATION:

The course takes place in Mnichovice (near Říčany), where a luxurious hall of the MTB & Trial Mraveniště club is ready this year. So you can train regardless of weather and light conditions. The venue is accessible by train, and parking is available in the closed site.

Mostly wooden obstacles on a rough concrete floor are available.

Hall location: Google Maps link

(it's a closed site that can only be entered by arrangement, accompanied by club members)

You can also walk to the venue from Mnichovice train station.


SUITABLE FOR:

Men, women and children (if there are enough participants, groups will be split by gender). Children only when accompanied by parents, on an individual basis. Ideal for experienced and amateur riders who love off-road riding.

CAPACITY, BOOKING AND PAYMENT TERMS:

Courses and camps have limited capacity. You can check availability in the header of the camp description (booked / total capacity), as well as the price. Your companions can attend, but we'll primarily focus on you and the other paying riders.

Bookings can be made using the form on this page or by e-mail to info@bikeskills.cz. Confirmation from us is required. We'll send you an invoice right away or, by arrangement, before the event (2–3 weeks). Payment must be made by the due date stated on the invoice.

Cancellation is possible for a fee of 50% of the total camp price 14 days before the event, or 90% of the total camp price 13 days or less before the event. Or by arrangement (injury, illness, force majeure).

By paying and attending the event, participants confirm that they take part at their own risk. The organiser is not responsible for loss of or damage to property.
